description: This file defines the ContactHelper utility class for managing contact mechanisms within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides static methods to retrieve contact mechanisms by various criteria such as party, type, and purpose, as well as a method to format credit card information.

classes.name: ContactHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for retrieving contact mechanisms related to a party in OFBiz.

methods.name: getContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party, optionally filtering by purpose and type, including or excluding old records.

methods.name: getContactMechByType
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party filtered by contact mechanism type.

methods.name: getContactMechByPurpose
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party filtered by contact mechanism purpose.

methods.name: formatCreditCard
methods.description: Formats credit card information by showing card type, last four digits, and expiry date.
